regional-governor.ts:
Ensure the named card cannot be played by any opponent of Regional Governor's player (all 2-3 of them).
Ensure an eliminated player is not affected (they are no longer a player).
Ensure that if another player takes control of Regional Governor, the restriction still applies to the original player's opponents (effect is not changed).
regional-governor.a2:
Ensure the named card cannot be played by either enemy player.
Ensure the named card can be played by the friendly teammate.

relentless#konstantines-folly.ts:
Ensure the first event played by each opponent each round loses all abilities, tracked separately per opponent (opponent B's first event is affected even if opponent A already played one).
Ensure an opponent's second and later events that round are unaffected, and that the tracking resets next round.
relentless#konstantines-folly.a2:
Ensure the first event played by each enemy player each round loses all abilities, tracked separately per enemy.
Ensure the friendly teammate's events are never affected.

admiral-ozzel#overconfident.ts:
Ensure every opponent may ready one unit of their own, each choosing independently, before the played Imperial unit's When Played abilities resolve.
Ensure eliminated players are not offered the choice.
admiral-ozzel#overconfident.a2:
Ensure both enemy players may ready a unit.
Ensure the friendly teammate is not offered the choice (not an opponent) and the played Imperial unit comes from your own hand only.

k2so#cassians-counterpart.ts:
Ensure that on defeat, the choice (3 damage to that player's base or discard a card) is made separately for each opponent, and each opponent's own base or hand is affected.
Ensure that when Overwhelm triggers on an attack in a 3-4 player game, the excess damage goes to the base of the defending player (the controller of the attacked unit).
k2so#cassians-counterpart.a2:
Ensure the When Defeated choice is made separately for each of the two enemy players, and the teammate is not affected.
Ensure Overwhelm excess damage goes to the base of whichever enemy controls the attacked unit.

saw-gerrera#extremist.ts:
Ensure every opponent must deal 2 damage to their own base as an additional cost to play an event, not just one.
Ensure that if the cost brings an opponent's base to 0, that opponent is eliminated and the event's ability does not resolve.
saw-gerrera#extremist.a2:
Ensure both enemy players must pay the 2 damage to their own base to play an event; the friendly teammate does not.
Ensure an enemy whose base is already at or past its health can still pay the 2 damage and play the event.

q.t: If the 2 damage cost puts an enemy base at or beyond its health, does the event's ability still not resolve (as the clarification says for a defeated base), or does it resolve normally because the player is not eliminated?

forced-surrender.ts:
Ensure only opponents whose base you damaged this phase discard 2 cards; opponents you did not damage are unaffected.
Ensure the draw 2 happens regardless of whether any opponent qualifies.
forced-surrender.a2:
Ensure only enemy players whose base you damaged this phase discard 2 cards.
Ensure damage dealt to the friendly teammate's base, or damage dealt by the teammate, does not count and the teammate never discards.

lothal-insurgent.ts: Ensure that if you played another card this phase, every opponent draws a card and then discards a random card from their hand.
lothal-insurgent.a2:
Ensure both enemy players draw then discard a random card when you played another card this phase.
Ensure a card played only by the teammate this phase does not satisfy the condition, and the teammate is not affected.

cripple-authority.ts: Ensure each opponent is compared to the controller separately: only opponents who control more resources than the controller discard a card, and opponents with equal or fewer do not.
cripple-authority.a2:
Ensure each enemy is compared separately against the controller's own resource count.
Ensure the teammate's resources are never counted and the teammate never discards.

qira#playing-her-part.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent's hand is looked at.
Ensure the named card costs 3 more for every opponent, including opponents whose hand was not looked at.
qira#playing-her-part.a2:
Ensure the controller can choose either enemy to look at, and the teammate cannot be chosen.
Ensure the named card costs 3 more for both enemies but not for the teammate.

no-bargain.ts: Ensure every opponent discards a card of their own choice from their own hand, and the controller draws only one card in total.
no-bargain.a2: Ensure both enemies each discard a card, the teammate does not discard, and the controller draws one card.

the-clone-wars.ts:
Ensure each opponent creates the full number of Battle Droid tokens, not a share.
Ensure the Clone Troopers are created only for the player who played the event.
the-clone-wars.a2:
Ensure both enemy players each create that many Battle Droid tokens.
Ensure the teammate creates no tokens.

senatorial-corvette.ts: Ensure when it is defeated, each opponent discards a card from their own hand.
senatorial-corvette.a2: Ensure when it is defeated, both enemy players each discard a card and the teammate does not.

ziro-the-hutt#colorful-schemer.ts:
Ensure When Played gives a separate optional choice for each opponent to exhaust a unit that player controls; declining for one does not affect the others.
Ensure On Attack likewise gives a separate optional choice per opponent to exhaust one of that player's resources.
ziro-the-hutt#colorful-schemer.a2:
Ensure both abilities give a separate optional choice for each of the two enemies.
Ensure the teammate's units and resources are never offered.

devastator#hunting-the-rebellion.ts: Ensure When Played deals 4 indirect damage to each opponent, with the Devastator controller assigning each opponent's damage among that opponent's units and base.
devastator#hunting-the-rebellion.a2:
Ensure 4 indirect damage is dealt to each enemy player, assigned by you among that enemy's units and base, and the teammate's units and base are not hit.
Ensure indirect damage dealt by a teammate's card is not assigned by you.

hunting-aggressor.ts: Ensure indirect damage you deal to each opponent is increased by 1, per opponent receiving it (dealt to two opponents, each gets +1).
hunting-aggressor.a2:
Ensure indirect damage you deal to your teammate (if a card allows targeting them) is not increased, since a teammate is not an opponent.
Ensure indirect damage dealt by a teammate's card is not increased.

jedi-in-hiding.ts: Ensure that when you use the Force, every opponent discards a card, each choosing their own.
jedi-in-hiding.a2: Ensure that when you use the Force, both enemy players discard a card and the teammate does not.

admiral-ozzel#as-clumsy-as-he-is-stupid.ts: Ensure every opponent discards a card from their own hand, each choosing their own card.
admiral-ozzel#as-clumsy-as-he-is-stupid.a2: Ensure both enemy players discard a card from their hand and the teammate does not.

emissarys-sheathipede.ts: Ensure every opponent may ready a resource, each deciding separately.
emissarys-sheathipede.a2: Ensure both enemies may each ready a resource, each deciding separately, and the teammate is not offered the choice.

duchesss-investigators.ts: Ensure that when you disclose Cunning, each opponent discards a random card from their own hand.
duchesss-investigators.a2:
Ensure that when you disclose Cunning, both enemies each discard a random card and the teammate does not.
Ensure disclose uses only your own hand, and the revealed card is seen by everyone, including your teammate.

rey#skywalker.ts: Ensure effects controlled by any opponent can't take control of her or defeat her directly, tested with more than one opponent.
rey#skywalker.a2:
Ensure neither enemy can take control of her or defeat her directly with a card ability.
Ensure the teammate is not an opponent, so the teammate's effects can take control of her or defeat her.

c3po#die-jedi-dogs.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent takes control of this unit, and the choice persists through the ability.
Ensure the Action can be used by every opponent of its current controller (including the original owner and the other opponents), never by its controller.
c3po#die-jedi-dogs.a2:
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate.
Ensure the Action can be used by the opponents of its current controller (the owner and the owner's teammate), and not by the controller's teammate.

wartime-profiteer.ts:
Ensure that when defeated, each opponent decides separately whether to ready a resource.
Open: whether the resource an opponent readies must be their own or can be any player's.
wartime-profiteer.a2:
Ensure both enemies each decide separately and the teammate is not offered the choice.
Open: whether the resource an enemy readies must be their own or can be any player's, including the teammate's.

ryder-azadi#restored-governor.ts:
Ensure the named card can't be played by any opponent while this unit is in play (check at least two opponents), but you can play it.
Ensure the restriction does not change if an opponent takes control of Ryder: it still applies to the same players.
ryder-azadi#restored-governor.a2: Ensure the named card can't be played by either enemy player, and can be played by your teammate.

dookus-solar-sailer#droid-army-portent.ts: Ensure every opponent discards a card from their hand.
dookus-solar-sailer#droid-army-portent.a2:
Ensure both enemies each discard a card and the teammate does not.
Ensure a teammate's unit costing 1 or less does not satisfy the condition.

giant-gorax.ts:
Ensure every opponent separately chooses one option, and the 3 damage can only hit a unit or base controlled by the opponent who chose it.
Ensure each opponent's discard and defeated resource come from their own hand and resources.
giant-gorax.a2:
Ensure only an Endor base you control enables it; a teammate's Endor base does not.
Ensure both enemies each choose separately, the teammate chooses nothing, and the 3 damage can only hit a unit or base of the choosing enemy.

raddus#hope-of-the-resistance.ts: Ensure while Raddus is exhausted, cards played by every opponent cost 3 more.
raddus#hope-of-the-resistance.a2: Ensure while Raddus is exhausted, cards played by both enemies cost 3 more and the teammate's do not.

count-dooku#silvertongued.ts: Ensure each opponent is limited to readying 1 ground unit and 1 space unit in the regroup phase, counted separately for each (check at least two opponents).
count-dooku#silvertongued.a2: Ensure both enemy players are limited, each counted separately, and the teammate is not limited.

del-meeko#providing-overwatch.ts: Ensure events played by every opponent cost 1 more, and events played by Del Meeko's controller do not.
del-meeko#providing-overwatch.a2:
Ensure events played by either enemy cost 1 more.
Ensure events played by the teammate cost no more.

avenger#hunting-star-destroyer.ts: Ensure the controlling player chooses which opponent is "an opponent", and only that opponent chooses and defeats one of their own non-leader units, leaving the other opponents' units unaffected.
avenger#hunting-star-destroyer.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses one of the two enemies, and only that enemy chooses and defeats a non-leader unit.
Ensure the teammate is never the chosen opponent and the teammate's units are not defeated.

power-of-the-dark-side.ts: Ensure the player who plays the event chooses which opponent is "an opponent", and only that opponent chooses and loses one unit they control, leaving the other opponents' units unaffected.
power-of-the-dark-side.a2:
Ensure the player chooses one of the two enemies, and only that enemy chooses and loses a unit.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen as the opponent.
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate.

vigilance.ts:
Ensure that if the discard mode is chosen, the player picks which single opponent's deck loses 6 cards from the top, and other opponents' decks are unchanged.
Ensure the other modes (heal a base, defeat a unit, Shield) behave as in 1v1.
vigilance.a2: Ensure the discard mode can only target an enemy's deck, never the teammate's.

seventh-sister#implacable-inquisitor.ts:
Ensure the attacker picks which opponent's base to attack, and the trigger's "that opponent" is the owner of the damaged base.
Ensure the 3 damage can only go to a ground unit controlled by that opponent, not another opponent's ground units.
seventh-sister#implacable-inquisitor.a2:
Ensure the trigger fires when combat damage is dealt to an enemy base and the 3 damage can only go to a ground unit that enemy controls.
Ensure a teammate's units cannot be chosen as the target, and a teammate's base cannot be attacked, so the trigger never fires for it.

chimaera#flagship-of-the-seventh-fleet.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent is "an opponent"; only that opponent reveals their hand and discards a card with the named name.
Ensure the other opponents' hands are not revealed.
chimaera#flagship-of-the-seventh-fleet.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses one of the two enemies; only that enemy reveals their hand and discards.
Ensure the teammate's hand is not revealed or discarded from.
Ensure the revealed hand is seen by everyone, including both teammates.
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate.

i-had-no-choice.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent is "an opponent", and that opponent (not the controller) chooses which of the units is returned to hand.
Ensure the chosen opponent makes the choice even when the selected units belong to different players.
i-had-no-choice.a2: Ensure the chooser is one of the two enemies picked by the controller, never the teammate.

spark-of-rebellion.ts:
Ensure the player chooses which single opponent's hand is looked at and discards a card from it; other opponents' hands are unaffected.
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent, and the choice persists through the ability.
spark-of-rebellion.a2:
Ensure the player chooses one of the two enemies' hands to look at and discard from, never the teammate's.
Ensure only the player sees the hand.

bodhi-rook#imperial-defector.ts: Ensure the controller chooses which single opponent's hand is looked at and discards a non-unit card from it; other opponents' hands are unaffected.
bodhi-rook#imperial-defector.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses one of the two enemies' hands, never the teammate's.
Ensure only the controller sees the hand.

cunning.ts:
Ensure that if the discard mode is chosen, the player picks which single opponent discards a random card from their hand; other opponents are unaffected.
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent, and the choice persists through the ability.
cunning.a2: Ensure the discard mode can only be aimed at one of the two enemies, never the teammate.

cad-bane#he-who-needs-no-introduction.ts:
Ensure that, on both sides, Cad Bane's controller chooses which opponent is "an opponent" and only that opponent chooses a unit they control and takes the damage.
Ensure the deployed once-each-round limit is shared across all opponents (using it on one opponent prevents using it on another that round).
cad-bane#he-who-needs-no-introduction.a2:
Ensure the opponent is chosen from the two enemies, never the teammate, and only that enemy chooses a unit they control and takes the damage.
Ensure it triggers only when you play an Underworld card, not when the teammate does.
Ensure the deployed once-each-round limit is shared across both enemies.

poe-dameron#quick-to-improvise.ts:
Ensure if the discard option is chosen, the controller picks which single opponent discards a card of that opponent's choice from their hand.
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent, and the choice persists through the ability.
poe-dameron#quick-to-improvise.a2:
Ensure the discard option can only target an enemy (either one), who chooses the card to discard; the teammate cannot be chosen.
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate.

stolen-landspeeder.ts:
Ensure the controlling player chooses which single opponent takes control of it, and only that opponent controls it afterward.
Ensure the Bounty does nothing when an opponent other than the owner collects it, including one who did not control it.
Open: if the opponent controlling it is eliminated, does it go to its owner's discard pile?
stolen-landspeeder.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses one of the two enemies to take control; the teammate cannot receive it.
Ensure the Bounty does nothing for the owner if the teammate defeats it, since the teammate does not own it.

krayt-dragon.ts: Ensure it triggers separately for each card played by any opponent, and the damage goes only to the base or a ground unit of the opponent who played that card, not another opponent's.
krayt-dragon.a2:
Ensure it triggers for cards played by either enemy, and the damage goes only to the base or ground units of the enemy who played the card, not the other enemy's.
Ensure cards played by the teammate do not trigger it.

bazine-netal#spy-for-the-first-order.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent's hand is looked at, with several opponents available.
Ensure the same opponent is the one whose card is discarded and who draws a card.
bazine-netal#spy-for-the-first-order.a2: Ensure the controller can choose either enemy, the teammate cannot be chosen, and only the chosen enemy's hand is looked at, discarded from and draws.

let-the-wookiee-win.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent is "an opponent", and that opponent chooses which mode the controller gets.
Ensure the other opponents make no choice and are unaffected.
Ensure the benefit goes to the controller: they ready up to 6 of their own resources, or ready a friendly unit and attack with it if it is a Wookiee.
let-the-wookiee-win.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses one of the two enemies; only that enemy chooses the mode, and the teammate is never chosen.
Ensure the benefit goes to the controller: their own resources, or a friendly unit (which can be the teammate's).
Ensure the attack can only be initiated with a unit you control, never with the teammate's unit.

q.t: If the controller readies a friendly Wookiee unit that belongs to the teammate, may the controller attack with it, even though an attack is never initiated with a teammate's unit?

grey-squadron-ywing.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent is "an opponent", and only that opponent chooses a unit or base they control.
Ensure the damage can only hit that choice, not another opponent's units or base.
grey-squadron-ywing.a2: Ensure the controller can choose either enemy, who then picks only a unit or base they control, and the teammate cannot be chosen.

satine-kryze#committed-to-peace.ts:
Ensure the unit's controller chooses which of their opponents' decks is discarded from, each use.
Ensure for an enemy unit its controller can choose Satine's controller or any other opponent.
satine-kryze#committed-to-peace.a2:
Ensure the teammate's units also gain the action, and their controller chooses between the two enemies, never their own teammate.
Ensure for an enemy unit the chosen opponent can be Satine's controller or Satine's teammate.
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate.

duchesss-champion.ts:
Ensure Sentinel is gained while any single opponent controls 3 or more units.
Ensure units split across opponents, with no single opponent at 3, do not grant Sentinel.
duchesss-champion.a2:
Ensure Sentinel is gained while either enemy individually controls 3 or more units.
Ensure units split across the two enemies, or the teammate's units, do not count toward the 3.

kiadimundi#composed-and-confident.ts: Ensure it triggers on each opponent's own second card that phase, counted per opponent: one card from each of two opponents does not trigger it.
kiadimundi#composed-and-confident.a2:
Ensure it triggers on either enemy's own second card, counted per enemy: one card from each enemy does not trigger it.
Ensure the teammate's plays never trigger it.

the-invasion-of-christophsis.ts: Ensure the controller chooses one opponent and only that player's units are defeated; other opponents' units survive.
the-invasion-of-christophsis.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses one of the two enemies and only that enemy's units are defeated; the other enemy's and the teammate's units survive.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen.
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate.

republic-defense-carrier.ts:
Ensure the discount equals the unit count of the single opponent who controls the most units, not the sum across opponents.
Ensure the discount follows the opponent who currently has the most units if that changes.
republic-defense-carrier.a2:
Ensure the discount equals the unit count of whichever enemy controls the most units, not the sum of both enemies.
Ensure the teammate's units are never counted.

jesse#hardfighting-patriot.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent creates the 2 Battle Droid tokens, and that opponent controls them.
Ensure the other opponents and the controller get no tokens.
jesse#hardfighting-patriot.a2:
Ensure the controller chooses one of the two enemies, who creates and controls the 2 tokens.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen and gets no tokens.
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate.

old-access-codes.ts:
Ensure the card is drawn if any single opponent controls more units than you, even when other opponents control fewer.
Ensure unit counts are compared per opponent, never summed across opponents.
old-access-codes.a2:
Ensure the card is drawn if either enemy individually controls more units than you.
Ensure only your own units count for you (the teammate's are not added) and the enemies' counts are not summed.

ahsoka-tano#always-ready-for-trouble.ts: Ensure Ambush is gained while any single opponent controls more units than you (counting this unit), and is lost when no opponent does.
ahsoka-tano#always-ready-for-trouble.a2:
Ensure Ambush is gained when either enemy individually controls more units than you; nothing is summed across the enemies.
Ensure only your own units count for you; the teammate's units are not added and the teammate is not an opponent.

lux-bonteri#renegade-separatist.ts: Ensure it triggers for any opponent's play made for less than the card's printed cost, evaluated per player, and not for your own discounted plays.
lux-bonteri#renegade-separatist.a2:
Ensure it triggers for either enemy's discounted play.
Ensure the teammate's discounted play never triggers it.

political-pressure.ts:
Ensure you choose which opponent is affected; only that opponent decides whether to discard.
Ensure other opponents' hands are untouched.
political-pressure.a2:
Ensure you choose one of the two enemies; only that enemy decides and discards.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen and the other enemy is unaffected.
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate.

unmasking-the-conspiracy.ts: Ensure you choose which opponent's hand is looked at, and the discard comes from that hand only.
unmasking-the-conspiracy.a2:
Ensure only an enemy can be chosen, never the teammate.
Ensure the looked-at hand is shown only to you, not to the teammate.

aggrieved-parliamentarian.ts:
Ensure you choose which opponent is affected.
Ensure only that opponent's discard pile is shuffled and put on the bottom of their deck; other opponents' piles are unchanged.
aggrieved-parliamentarian.a2:
Ensure you choose one of the two enemies, and only that enemy's discard pile is shuffled to the bottom of their deck.
Ensure the teammate cannot be chosen and their discard pile is unchanged.
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate.

admiral-trench#chkchkchkchk.ts: Ensure the controlling player chooses which opponent is "an opponent" and the choice persists through the ability; only that opponent discards 2 of the revealed cards.
admiral-trench#chkchkchkchk.a2:
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate; only that enemy discards 2 of the revealed cards.
Ensure the revealed cards are seen by everyone, including the teammate.

youre-all-clear-kid.ts:
Ensure the defeated unit can be any opponent's space unit.
Ensure the "an opponent controls no space units" check is true if any one opponent controls none, even while another opponent still has space units.
youre-all-clear-kid.a2:
Ensure only an enemy's space unit can be chosen, never the teammate's.
Ensure the "an opponent controls no space units" check is true if either enemy individually controls none, and the teammate's space units are not counted.

seasoned-fleet-admiral.ts: Ensure it triggers when any one opponent draws 1 or more cards during the action phase, including an opponent who is not the active player.
seasoned-fleet-admiral.a2:
Ensure it triggers when either enemy draws 1 or more cards during the action phase.
Ensure it does not trigger when the teammate draws.

air-superiority.ts:
Ensure the condition is true if you control more space units than any one opponent, with no opponent chosen for the comparison.
Ensure the controller chooses an opponent they outnumber in space units and the 4 damage goes to a ground unit that opponent controls; an opponent with as many or more space units cannot be chosen.
air-superiority.a2:
Ensure only the space units you control count for you; the teammate's space units count for no one.
Ensure the controller chooses one enemy they outnumber in space units and the 4 damage goes to a ground unit that enemy controls, never the teammate's.

timely-reinforcements.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent, and the choice persists through the ability.
Ensure the number of X-Wing tokens is based only on the chosen opponent's resources.
timely-reinforcements.a2:
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate.
Ensure the number of X-Wing tokens is based only on the chosen enemy's resources; the teammate's are not counted.

they-hate-that-ship.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent, and the choice persists through the ability.
Ensure only the chosen opponent creates and readies the 2 TIE Fighter tokens.
they-hate-that-ship.a2:
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate.
Ensure only the chosen enemy receives the TIE Fighter tokens.

moff-gideon#i-know-everything.ts: Ensure that when Gideon deals combat damage to a base, only the opponent who controls that base has their played units cost 1 more this phase, and other opponents are unaffected.
moff-gideon#i-know-everything.a2: Ensure only the enemy whose base was damaged has their played units cost 1 more this phase; the other enemy, you and your teammate are unaffected.

ahsoka-tano#chasing-whispers.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent, and the choice persists through the ability.
Ensure other opponents' hands are untouched.
ahsoka-tano#chasing-whispers.a2: Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate.

home-one#on-my-mark.ts: Ensure the cost reduction applies if any one opponent controls 3 or more space units; space units are not combined across opponents (2 and 2 does not qualify).
home-one#on-my-mark.a2: Ensure the teammate's space units do not count, and the discount applies when either enemy individually controls 3 or more space units; 2 and 2 across the two enemies does not qualify.

jam-communications.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent, and the choice persists through the ability.
Ensure only that opponent's hand is seen and has an event discarded.
jam-communications.a2:
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate.
Ensure only you see the hand (you may tell your teammate).

never-tell-me-the-odds.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent, and the choice persists through the ability.
Ensure only that opponent's deck loses cards, besides your own.
never-tell-me-the-odds.a2:
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate.
Ensure the teammate's deck is not affected.

its-a-trap.ts: Ensure the condition is true if any one opponent controls more space units than you, with no opponent chosen; nothing is summed across opponents.
its-a-trap.a2:
Ensure the condition is true if either enemy individually controls more space units than you; nothing is summed across the two enemies.
Ensure the teammate's space units are not counted as yours and are not readied; only your own space units ready.

stolen-athauler.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent, and the choice persists through the ability.
Ensure the other opponents cannot play it from the discard pile.
stolen-athauler.a2:
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate.
Ensure the teammate and the other enemy gain no permission to play it.

cal-kestis#i-cant-keep-hiding.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent, and the choice persists through the ability (leader Action and deployed On Attack).
Ensure only the chosen opponent picks a ready unit they control to exhaust; other opponents' units are unaffected.
cal-kestis#i-cant-keep-hiding.a2:
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate.
Ensure only the chosen enemy picks one of their own ready units to exhaust; the teammate's units are never affected.

the-tragedy-of-plagueis.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent, and the choice persists through the ability.
Ensure only the chosen opponent chooses a unit they control to defeat; other opponents' units are untouched.
the-tragedy-of-plagueis.a2:
Ensure the friendly unit can be the teammate's unit as well as your own.
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate, and only that enemy chooses and defeats one of their own units.

watto#no-money-no-parts-no-deal.ts:
Ensure the controller chooses which opponent, and the choice persists through the ability.
Ensure only the chosen opponent picks the mode.
watto#no-money-no-parts-no-deal.a2:
Ensure the choice is either enemy, never the teammate, and only that enemy picks the mode.
Ensure the Experience token can go to the teammate's unit as well as your own.
